svg.title: Levels of analysis
svg.desc: Three levels of analysis, trading detail for scale. Individual: one specific person. Question it answers: would THIS person like these search results? How you model it: a detailed persona prompt plus memory of their history. Failure mode: noise, because people are inconsistent and data per person is sparse. Group: a few people who interact. Question: how would these two resolve this conflict? Model: several individual agents with memory, interacting over ticks. Failure mode: dynamics may never be fully predictable. Population: many people, aggregated. Question: do older adults read more than younger ones? Model: sample N personas from demographics and average the answers. Failure mode: too coarse, and can reproduce bias and stereotypes. Group means interactions between people; population means interventions on the whole.
svg.text: and data per person is sparse
